candidate.name: R44BW_EXPLICIT_BINARY_EQUALITY_CONGRUENCE_QUOTIENT
candidate.source_claim: Explicit certified equalities are collapsed by substitution, tautologies and duplicates are removed, and models lift by copying representative values along equality classes.

central_question: For the exact R44BW congruence quotient Q, does Q(F)=Q(G) imply SAT(F)=SAT(G)?

proof_lane.obligation_1: Every detected same-orientation equality edge is justified by the exact clause pair (not u or v) AND (u or not v).
proof_lane.obligation_2: Any model of the original formula is constant on every generated equality class and therefore projects to a model of the quotient.
proof_lane.obligation_3: Any model of the quotient lifts to a model of the original formula by copying each representative value to its equality class.
proof_lane.obligation_4: Tautology deletion, duplicate-clause deletion, and bijective dense variable renaming preserve SAT.
proof_lane.required_theorem: SAT(F) iff SAT(Q(F)); therefore equal quotient fibers are SAT-monochromatic.

counterexample_lane.search: Generate adversarial CNFs with explicit equality chains, contradictory constraints, redundant equality edges, tautologies, duplicate clauses, and renamed equality classes; group them by exact canonical quotient and search for a mixed SAT/UNSAT fiber.
